sn56.61:1.1: Atha kho Bhagavā parittam nakhasikhāyam paṃsum āropetvā bhikkhū āmantesi || || 3.
sn56.61:1.3: katamaṃ nu kho bahutaraṃ || pe || paritto nakhasikhāyam paṃsu āropito || ayaṃ vā mahāpathavī ti || ||
sn56.61:1.4: Etad eva bhante bahutaraṃ yad idam mahāpathavī || appamattako yam Bhagavatā paritto nakhasikhāyam paṃsu āropito
sn56.61:1.5: saṅkham pi na upeti upanidham pi na upeti kalabhāgam pi na upeti mahāpathavim upanidhāya Bhagavatā paritto nakhasikhāyam paṃsu āropito ti || || 4.
sn56.61:2.1: Evam eva kho bhikkhave appakā te sattā ye manussesu paccājāyanti || atha kho ete bahutarā sattā ye aññatra manussehi paccājāyanti || ||
sn56.61:2.5: Dukkhassa ariyasaccassa || la-pe || dukkhanirodhagāminiyā paṭipādāya ariyasaccassa || || 6.
sn56.61:3.1: Tasmā ti ha bhikkhave Idaṃ dukkhan ti yogo karaṇīyo || la-pe || Ayam dukkhanirodhagāminī patipadā ti yogo karaṇīyo
